subject: Convert Shiny application to ASP.NET application

messages.author: 1632c542d3902167
messages.subject: Convert Shiny application to ASP.NET application
parts:
Hello, 

I want deploy my shiny on a windows 2008 r2 server, which manages website using Umbraco content management system(https://umbraco.com/). Umbraco only supports .NET applications. 
Can  anyone  please tell me out with this issue?

Thank  you

messages.author: 5ab11db47365dff1
messages.subject: Re: Convert Shiny application to ASP.NET application
parts:
Windows is not supported for Shiny Server Open Source, so there's no way you'll be able to host the app natively.

If it's acceptable, host the shiny app externally using your own VPS or shinyapps.io.

Perhaps the most transparent solution is hosting the app on an external VPS and using iframes to include the app on your server. 





Erik
